summary: First test run – both backend and frontend tested end-to-end. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests pass (meta, items for all 5 categories, item details incl. SOCR + Lonewolf set_effects, image proxy, news list/detail, guides list/detail for shrapnel with videos+wiki articles, translate cs, chat SSE streaming + history + delete, bridge manifest/search/auth 401/authorized ask, POST /api/sync). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Home hero with latest-patch-card, Codex (search 'socr' returns 2 items, filter chips visible, 83 záznamů count), Item detail legendary card renders beautifully (gold frame, cinematic image, rarity ribbon 'LEGENDARY', parchment stats panel with Weight/Durability/DMG, Czech auto-translation 'Překládám do češtiny…' → translated summary, 'Zeptat se AI' button), armor set Lonewolf renders with set effects, Guides list with Základy/Combat/World groups and Video/Wiki badges, Guide detail (shrapnel) shows YouTube video thumbnails on web (correct – native-only playback), verified wiki article with translate button, AI assistant streams Czech answer in ~2s with 6 sources (ACS12, AUG, AWS.338…), News list with Vše/Patch filter chips, Settings shows Čeština/English toggle, sync status (last sync 18.10.2026), AI Bridge section with Base URL/OpenAPI/X-Bridge-Token (ohg-bridge-7f3k9q2m)/Export JSON copy buttons. All testIDs present (60+). No deprecated expo packages, no red-screen errors, no PAGEERROR events.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is high: BaseDocument uses PyObjectId BeforeValidator to serialize ObjectId; CARD_PROJ/ITEM_PROJ explicitly exclude _id → no ObjectId leakage.
server.py is 413 lines, well-structured. wiki.py 343 lines (parser), fine.
Caching layer in db.cache with graceful fallback (serves stale on upstream failure) – excellent for live wiki/news.
Streaming SSE uses proper media_type=text/event-stream and X-Accel-Buffering: no header – correctly disables proxy buffering.
Bridge token auth via _check() strips 'Bearer ' prefix (optional support) and 401s on mismatch – working.
Minor nit (non-blocking): /api/meta count for armor_mods shows 57 in counts vs 58 in last sync (one stale item). Not a bug – happens between syncs.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Chat test session (TEST_sess_*) is cleaned up at end of test via DELETE /api/chat/{session_id}. Translation cache entries (TEST_tr_*) remain but are harmless and prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py (30 tests, pytest-xdist safe, ~11s cold). Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from backend .env (NOT a default literal). Known external deps: once-human.fandom.com (wiki sync), Steam news API, YouTube scrape, Emergent LLM (Claude). First call to a new guide can take 20-40s because of live wiki+YT fetch; subsequent calls use db.cache. Video objects use 'video_id' key (not 'id').
